# thesupersuperanime.lol

> A personal anime streaming site with a full episode library, community features, and a leaderboard.

## What this site does
- Stream anime episodes with sub and dub support
- Track watch history and progress across episodes
- Community comments on episodes
- Watchlist management
- Genre browsing and community genre voting
- Global leaderboard ranked by minutes watched
- User profiles

## Key pages
- / — Home feed with trending and seasonal anime
- /search — Search and filter anime by genre, format, status, season, year
- /anime/[id] — Anime detail page with episode list
- /watch/[animeId]/[episodeNum] — Episode watch page
- /leaderboard — Global watch time leaderboard
- /genres — Browse anime by genre
- /user/[username] — Public user profiles

## Notes
- Authentication is required to post comments, manage watchlists, and appear on the leaderboard
- Anonymous browsing is supported when the site is in open mode
